metric_definitions.relevant set R: judged chunks with grade >= 2 that are retrievable now (authorization 2). Grade -1 is not in R; grade 1 is not in R
metric_definitions.recall@K: |top-K ∩ R| / |R|; denominator = KNOWN relevant only (unpooled relevant chunks unknown) → recall w.r.t. the judged set, not a bound on true recall
metric_definitions.precision_lb@K: |top-K ∩ R| / |top-K|; unjudged counted as not relevant → LOWER bound
metric_definitions.precision_ub@K: (|top-K ∩ R| + unjudged in top-K) / |top-K|; every unjudged counted relevant → UPPER bound
metric_definitions.judged_precision@K: |top-K ∩ R| / |judged in top-K| (judged-only precision; None if nothing judged)
metric_definitions.mrr: 1 / rank of first chunk in R within top-20 (0 if none) — LOWER bound; mrr_ub = 1 / rank of first chunk that is in R OR unjudged
metric_definitions.unjudged_before_first_relevant: number of unjudged chunks ranked above the first relevant one (MRR sensitivity)
metric_definitions.ndcg@K: DCG with gain 3→7, 2→3, 1→1, 0→0, unjudged→0, -1→0 (and excluded from the ideal); IDCG from all judged retrievable chunks; LOWER bound
metric_definitions.ndcg_t231_lb@K: T2.3.1 definition (linear gain 3,2,1,0, -1→2) — kept only for comparability
metric_definitions.source_recall@K: |distinct source_id in top-K ∩ S| / |S|, S = distinct source_id of R (deduplicated by source)
metric_definitions.judged_coverage@K: judged chunks in top-K / |top-K| (judged = any final grade -1..3 in that label set); micro = Σjudged/Σretrieved, macro = mean of per-question values
metric_definitions.conflict_coverage@20: grade -1 chunks in top-20 / grade -1 retrievable chunks (conflict aspect only)
